Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the upper radiator support is bent, with the hood latch and both headlamp
brackets displaced. The crush pattern and paint transfer on the bumper line up with a frontal strike of this kind, and nothing I
found points to older damage on this vehicle. The shop's plan is to replace the bumper cover, radiator support, latch and both
brackets, then realign and refinish the front end. The labor horus on the estimate run a bit above what I would expect for this
scope, so I have asked the shop to justify several line items before final approval. The invoices submitted so far do not show any
duplicate charges.
